step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Folded Cascode Operational Amplifier
step1_analysis.description: A fully differential folded cascode op-amp with continuous-time common-mode feedback (CMFB). It is likely used in the switched-capacitor integrator of the sigma-delta modulator described in the paper. Note: The extracted netlist appears to have an error where one half of the PMOS input pair (XM18) was incorrectly extracted as an NMOS device, which will severely impact its differential operation.

paper_reference.title: A 14-Bit High-Temperature Modulator in Standard CMOS

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_in * Rout. With L=0.5um, intrinsic gain gm*ro is around 20-30. Folded cascode gain is roughly (gm*ro)^2, so ~60-80 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected gain is lower than the 106 dB reported in the paper due to the shorter channel length (0.5um vs 1.5um) and lower supply voltage (1.8V) in SKY130, as well as the likely extraction error in the input pair.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm_in / (2 * pi * CL). Assuming gm_in ~ 1mA/V and CL = 1pF, UGBW ~ 160 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias currents and load capacitance. A typical value for this topology in 130nm is 10-100 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole location relative to UGBW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A phase margin of at least 60 degrees is typically targeted for stable closed-loop operation in switched-capacitor circuits.

sky130_expected.calculation: Sum of currents in all branches * VDD. Assuming ~100uA per branch and 4 main branches, total current ~400uA. Power = 400uA * 1.8V = 720uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales with the bias voltages applied. The added bias sources will determine the exact power.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, UGBW, phase margin, and power consumption of the fully differential folded cascode op-amp. Bias voltage sources were added for floating nodes (N7, N9, N11, N16) to allow the simulation to converge.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Fully Differential Folded Cascode Op-Amp

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm_in_p=5u L_xm_in_p=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm_bias_n=5u L_xm_bias_n=0.5u
.param W_xmc1=5u L_xmc1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xmc2_r=5u L_xmc2_r=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm_bias_p=5u L_xm_bias_p=0.5u
.param W_xmc2_l=5u L_xmc2_l=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xmc3=5u L_xmc3=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u

XM9 N10 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM5 N4 N11 N15 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM_IN_P N12 VIN_PLUS N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm_in_p} w={W_xm_in_p}
XM10 N12 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM_BIAS_N N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm_bias_n} w={W_xm_bias_n}
XMC1 N5 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc1} w={W_xmc1}
XM3 N15 N9 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XMC2_R N5 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc2_r} w={W_xmc2_r}
XM8 N3 N7 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM_BIAS_P LABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm_bias_p} w={W_xm_bias_p}
XMC2_L N2 VCMSET VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc2_l} w={W_xmc2_l}
XM7 N4 N7 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM11 N0 N16 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM4 N14 N9 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM6 N3 N11 N14 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM16 N1 N16 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XMC3 N2 VCMSET VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmc3} w={W_xmc3}
XM18 N0 VIN_MINUS N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVIN_PLUS VIN_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1k 0 0)
VVIN_MINUS VIN_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 SIN(0.9 -0.1 1k 0 0)
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VVCMSET VCMSET 0 0.9

* Added bias sources for floating nodes
VN7 N7 0 0.9
VN9 N9 0 1.2
VN11 N11 0 0.6
VN16 N16 0 0.9

E_diff out_diff 0 vol='v(N4) - v(N3)'
CL1 N4 0 1p
CL2 N3 0 1p

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(out_diff))

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm_phase find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let phase_margin = pm_phase + 180
print phase_margin

tran 1u 5m
meas tran vout_max max v(out_diff)
meas tran vout_min min v(out_diff)
quit
.endc
.end
